primary_metric: unweighted mean of 20 bin-specific R2 values

heldout_comparison_protocol.primary_method_comparison: equal-weight mean prediction from the five existing grouped-fold checkpoints for each model class
heldout_comparison_protocol.reason: uses the same cross-validation development protocol for every model and requires no heldout-based epoch selection
heldout_comparison_protocol.full_development_refit: also fit locked Raw+RC and Raw-no-RC models on all development observations for a final deployable model

raw_rc.epoch_rule: median of five CV best epochs [14, 11, 10, 12, 7]

raw_no_rc.epoch_rule: median of five CV best epochs [4, 12, 5, 6, 8]

frozen_nt_attnpool.epoch_rule: median rounded down from five CV best epochs [5, 5, 4, 4, 4]

motif_transformer.epoch_rule: median of five CV best epochs [9, 5, 8, 7, 6]

test_policy: No hyperparameter, architecture, epoch, or model-selection change may be based on heldout performance.
